Small-action links in the post stream render at 70% lightness of $primary in light themes — near-invisible pale text on light backgrounds — instead of the previous readable 30%; this is the only hunk in the diff that alters the light-theme value, indicating a typo.

records.issue_text: [BUG] The light-theme branch of the small-action h3 color was changed from 20% to 50% lightness, while desktop/topic-post.scss keeps 20% for the same element — both branches of dark-light-choose are now 50%, making the dark/light distinction a no-op and diverging from desktop. The small-action heading (e.g. 'n votes') on mobile renders at 50% lightness in both themes, noticeably lighter than the 20% used on desktop for the same element, so mobile and desktop show different weights for identical content.
records.rationale: Verified in `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss` within the `a.star` block: `h3` color changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, which raises the light-theme lightness from 20% to 50%.
